title: MAML initialization with Mirror-only inner loop
hypothesis: For Givens-orbit linear tasks, a shared meta-initialization plus two-coordinate Mirror inner loop reaches heldout query NRMSE within 1.10x full MAML at <=60% per-task inference bytes and matches rank-two LoRA.

task.teacher: shared vector with random Givens rotation in fixed 2D subspace

development.selection_metric: mean query NRMSE over dev tasks

success_gate: Every fresh world Mirror query NRMSE <=1.10x full MAML; per-task bytes <=60% full MAML; Mirror <=1.10x rank2 LoRA quality at no greater bytes.
failure_gate: Any quality/byte gate fails or LoRA matches Mirror at lower total bytes.
boundaries: Teacher is aligned to the Mirror orbit.
Small linear task only; no natural task or neural-network transfer claim.
Basis and decoder bytes are charged.
